news.title: Save the dates: Help shape the future of Wisconsin’s universities

news.title: Where an art education can take you
news.summary_en: Following an illustrious career, Professor Emerita Laurie Beth Clark is putting on a massive exhibition to showcase the work and lives of her former graduate students.
